answer_1.quote: STYLEPTB provides a large-scale resource to study fine-grained compositional style transfer.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences with different styles after fine-grained style transfers

answer_2.quote: Automated evaluation metrics consists of automatic BLEU scores, METEOR scores, ROUGE_L scores, and CiDER scores between generated and ground truth sentences.

answer_4.quote: In addition, we did human evaluations on random sets of 10 samples generated by each model for each transfer. We followed prior work and had 2 independent annotators each rate transferred sentences on three aspects (clarity/grammar, content preservation, style change) on a 1-5 Likert scale, and takes average.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated transferred sentences on clarity/grammar, content preservation, and style change using a 1-5 Likert scale.
